prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a giraffe as an exaggerated laughing reaction sticker. Center a plump, golden-yellow baby giraffe in a tight front-facing bust crop, its oversized round head thrown back mid-cackle. Give it a short visible neck, a few warm brown patches, two stubby ossicones, and small ears sticking out sideways. Squeeze its eyes shut into upward curves, puff up its cheeks, and make its wide-open mouth dominate the lower half of its face, with a dark reddish interior, a pink tongue, and two tiny upper teeth. Keep the squat proportions and the unabashed, almost scream-like belly laugh. Render it as a soft, brightly lit 3D cartoon with smooth toy-like surfaces and a plain white background. No text, captions, or props.
